evidence.detail: rs/d/w creates one item-id-to-integer table per rs/d/w$a currency type and loads each exact configs/<enum filename> YAML file with SnakeYAML.
Its formatter checks each currency table for the item id and appends the mapped numeric value using the exact surviving template ' @cya@(<img=<icon>>%,d)' with the enum's icon id.

The Client item-hover path calls this formatter with the item id and item display string before hover-description rendering, while the HoverDescriptionsPlugin configuration gate controls whether these currency values are added.

candidates.note: BloodCurrencyValueConfig is the conservative semantic name for these exact blood-core/diamond/shard per-item value tables; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/d/w$a is an enum with surviving exact constants CORE_TOKENS, DIAMONDS and SHARDS.
The constants bind exact icon ids and YAML filenames: CORE_TOKENS -> 180 / blood_core.yaml, DIAMONDS -> 67 / blood_diamonds.yaml, SHARDS -> 68 / blood_shards.yaml.
BloodCurrencyValueConfig iterates every enum constant, uses its filename to load the corresponding item-value table and its icon id when rendering the mapped value in item hover text.

candidates.note: BloodCurrencyType is the conservative semantic name for this exact three-value blood-currency enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
